north_star: Tokenless action-consequence rule construction, no transformers; independent of WSP120
hypothesis: A compositional GF2 relation memory predicts unseen Boolean action-consequence input patterns for degree<=2 laws after 12 physically observed interventions, but cannot identify high-order alternatives deliberately identical on all 12 observations. A single actual held-out outcome provides microfeedback that supports exact later recall, not generalization.

source.classification: inspectable synthetic TRAIN family, not independently hidden science

design.public_input: four bits: context c and three chosen 0/1 earlier actions; physically selected fourth distractor; reward ±1 revealed only after fourth action
design.monomial_features: constant plus four single bits and all six distinct pair products, full rank 11 on frozen 12 training patterns
design.adversarial: world i+8 shares all 12 public training outcomes with world i but flips exactly one of the four unseen patterns at index i%4; physical chosen action receipts not private labels
design.learner: online source-independent GF2 innovation elimination, minimum-degree relation synthesis from observations, no operator names; bounded explicit correction cache after actual new evidence
design.comparison: each method receives same 12 real training outcomes and predicts each of four unseen combinations before physical source action, then updates direct feedback cache and verifies cold retrieval only; no hidden private law or source mask in model interface

negative_controls: no reward before fourth chosen action
shuffled mapping cannot win as lawful source

classification.engineering: frozen first prereg, source SHA and 2OS focused plus mandatory G29 and full root tests, exact source-only generated child
classification.development: base family degree<=2 prediction; paired adversarial counterexample; witnessed cold feedback repair
classification.scientific: UNVERIFIED: no independent new hidden-law first use, strongest exact symbolic tie not superiority, no native main/merge
